question: The football club Mohun Bagan was founded in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1889**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Established on 15th August 1889, Mohun Bagan Athletic Club is one of the oldest clubs in India & Asia.
 
• It created history in 1911 by becoming the first Indian team to win IFA Shield, an event that has been closely linked with Indian nationalism.
